```{r}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Time vector
time <- seq(0, 75, by = 0.1)

# Baseline pupil size
baseline <- 96 + rnorm(length(time), 0, 1)

# Event times
events <- c(3, 14, 25, 36, 47, 57)

# Drop amplitudes (depth of constriction)
dip_amplitude <- c(8, 28, 10, 18, 45, 55)

# Recovery time constant (same as before)
tau_recovery <- 1.2

# Initialize dip signal
dips <- rep(0, length(time))

# Abrupt onset + exponential recovery
for (i in seq_along(events)) {
  onset <- time >= events[i]
  dips[onset] <- dips[onset] -
    dip_amplitude[i] * exp(-(time[onset] - events[i]) / tau_recovery)
}

# Final signal
pupil_size <- baseline + dips
pupil_size[pupil_size < 0] <- 0

# Plot
plot(
  time, pupil_size,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "red",
  xlab = "Time (s)",
  ylab = "Pupil Size (%)",
  ylim = c(0, 120)
)

```

```{r}
time <- seq(0, 75, by = 0.1)

set.seed(321)

# Time vector
time <- seq(0, 75, by = 0.05)

# Baseline with mild noise
baseline <- 96 + rnorm(length(time), 0, 0.7)

# Stimulus events
events <- c(3, 14, 25, 36, 47, 57)
dip_amplitude <- c(8, 28, 10, 18, 45, 55)
tau_recovery <- 1.2

# Event-related pupil constrictions
dips <- rep(0, length(time))
for (i in seq_along(events)) {
  idx <- time >= events[i]
  dips[idx] <- dips[idx] -
    dip_amplitude[i] * exp(-(time[idx] - events[i]) / tau_recovery)
}

# --- Blink artifacts ---
n_blinks <- 35
blink_times <- sort(runif(n_blinks, 1, 75))
blink_depth <- runif(n_blinks, 6, 18)      # how deep the blink is
blink_width <- runif(n_blinks, 0.03, 0.08) # how brief it is

blinks <- rep(0, length(time))
for (i in seq_len(n_blinks)) {
  blinks <- blinks -
    blink_depth[i] * exp(-((time - blink_times[i])^2) /
                          (2 * blink_width[i]^2))
}

# Combine all components
pupil_size_N <- baseline + dips + blinks
pupil_size_N[pupil_size_N < 0] <- 0

# Plot
plot(
  time, pupil_size_N,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "black",
  xlab = "Time (s)",
  ylab = "Pupil Size (%)",
  ylim = c(0, 120)
)
lines(pupil_size, col = "red")

```

```{r}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(321)

# Time vector
time <- seq(0, 75, by = 0.05)

# Baseline pupil size
baseline <- 96 + rnorm(length(time), 0, 0.7)

# Stimulus events
events <- c(3, 14, 25, 36, 47, 57)
dip_amplitude <- c(8, 28, 10, 18, 45, 55)
tau_recovery <- 1.2

# ----- Event-related constrictions -----
dips <- rep(0, length(time))
for (i in seq_along(events)) {
  idx <- time >= events[i]
  dips[idx] <- dips[idx] -
    dip_amplitude[i] * exp(-(time[idx] - events[i]) / tau_recovery)
}

# Clean pupil signal
pupil_clean <- baseline + dips
pupil_clean[pupil_clean < 0] <- 0

# ----- Blink artifacts -----
n_blinks <- 35
blink_times <- sort(runif(n_blinks, 1, 75))
blink_depth <- runif(n_blinks, 6, 18)
blink_width <- runif(n_blinks, 0.03, 0.08)

blinks <- rep(0, length(time))
for (i in seq_len(n_blinks)) {
  blinks <- blinks -
    blink_depth[i] * exp(-((time - blink_times[i])^2) /
                          (2 * blink_width[i]^2))
}

# Artifact-contaminated signal
pupil_artifact <- pupil_clean + blinks
pupil_artifact[pupil_artifact < 0] <- 0

# ----- Plot both curves -----
plot(
  time, pupil_artifact,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  col = "lightgreen",
  xlab = "Time (s)",
  ylab = "Pupil Size (%)",
  ylim = c(0, 120)
)

lines(
  time, pupil_clean,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "lightsalmon"
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("With artifacts", "Clean signal"),
  col = c("lightgreen", "lightsalmon"),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)

```
